items.title: 52150_Charlie Barnet oral history interview
items.q: I think it was Ann Shirley and Phillip Barry were in the picture. I have no idea what the picture was about.

ctx.x: Well, it wasn't my orchestra. It was the studio orchestra, because I had been having my jousts with the -- I went through induction seven times, you know, and everytime you figure, well, of course, this is it. And I was never in 4-F, and either they changed the laws or one time the guy decided I was a lush, but anyway, I finally decided I can't keep a band when I don't know what's going to happen. So I had come out to California. And I got this picture. Of course I didn't have a band, and they said, well, that's…

part of them and recorded these things, and then they used a sideline group for the actual filming. I think it was Ann Shirley and Phillip Barry were in the picture. I have no idea what the picture was about.
It doesn't say here. Which Bakaleinikoff, Mischa or Constantine?
